scope: Adding a Thunderbird email account now happens in one go, and Chrome setup is on by default.

topics.title: Chrome setup is on by default
details: The installer now checks the box to set up Chrome and the Voice Companion extension.
If Chrome is already set up, nothing happens and you hear nothing.
If it is not set up yet, Companion asks you when it opens.

topics.title: Sign in to Gmail in your own browser
details: When you add Gmail or Outlook, you sign in with your own web browser, such as Firefox or Chrome.
Companion tells you which browser it opened.
Google no longer stops you after you type your email address.
When the account is ready, Companion comes back to the front by itself.

topics.title: Adding a Thunderbird account
details: Say Add account once. Companion goes through every step with you.
You no longer have to say Add account again after each step.
If Thunderbird must close and open again, Companion does it for you.
If Thunderbird is slow to connect, Companion restarts it once by itself.
If the link to Thunderbird needs an update, Companion does it and goes on.

topics.title: Yes or no questions
details: Every Thunderbird question now tells you all the ways to answer.
Say yes or no, or press Y or N.
You can also use the arrows to choose, then press Enter.
